results.repairRoleEvidence: If caught early you may only need fresh rubber diff mounting bushings, but the proven bulletproofing fix is a reinforcement kit: weld in a Moss/Sport Car Parts differential-mount repair kit that adds new studs, brackets and (on the front) reinforcing plates that spread the load and stop the crack from returning.
notes: No reviewed component-to-catalog mapping; no catalog request was made.
